entities.name: Jimak Ravelth
entities.description: Master of the Purple House of Ingkara in Estark; easily bribed, he betrayed the other Houses.

entities.name: Purple House of Ingkara
entities.description: A House of Estark led by Jimak Ravelth.

entities.name: Estark
entities.description: City on Dominaria where Jimak was a House master.

entities.name: Night of Fire
entities.description: The destruction of the House of Oor-tael, in which Jimak took part.

entities.name: Zarel
entities.description: A leader who attacked the other Houses and bribed Jimak to betray them.

events.summary: At the end of the Time of Troubles, Zarel bribed Jimak to betray the other houses and side with him.
events.quote: he bribed Jimak to betray the other houses and side with him

events.summary: After the battle, Jimak hid his spells and committed suicide by poison, denying Zarel a final victory.
events.quote: he hid his spells and committed suicide by poison
